<!-- THE STORY — proven work in Biong                -->
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

    <h2 style="font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.2vw, 2.35rem); color: #0B1F3B; margin: 0 0 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2;">We Have Served Before</h2>
    <div style="width: 60px; height: 3px; background-color: #D4A017; margin-bottom: 1.6rem;"></div>

    <div class="about-story-grid" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 1fr; gap: 3rem; align-items: center;">
      <div>
        <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;">
          From 2006, Y.E.T. Compassion served the <strong style="color: #0B1F3B;">Biong community</strong> in South Sudan — drilling water wells, delivering food aid and medical supplies, and supporting schooling for the community's children. The work was practical, local, and carried out alongside the people it served.
        </p>
        <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;">
          When war broke out in <strong style="color: #0B1F3B;">2013</strong>, families were displaced and the work on the ground was forced to stop. For years, the door to Biong and to South Sudan's most vulnerable communities remained closed.
        </p>
        <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 0;">
          Now conditions have opened the door to return. The mission resumes where it matters most: <strong style="color: #0B1F3B;">educating the next generation</strong> — in partnership with local churches, community leaders, and organizations on the ground.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <img src="/images/web/well.jpg" alt="Children at a water well site drilled by Y.E.T. Compassion in the Biong community" style="border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(11,31,59,0.2); width: 100%; display: block;">
        <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #8A8985; margin: 0.8rem 0 0; text-align: center;">A well site in the Biong community — one of the wells drilled before the war.</p>
      </div>
